settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure speech recognition engines, AI polish, and shortcuts

polish.title: AI Polish
polish.off_d: No LLM correction; only local rule cleanup (filler removal / punctuation / homophone fix).
polish.light_d: Local rules + LLM proofreading only (fixes ASR errors, keeps wording).
polish.heavy_d: Local rules + LLM rewriting (smoothing, reordering, preserving meaning).
polish.stylePackHint: In Heavy mode, the selected style pack replaces the default polish prompt (F1)
polish.stylePromptPh: system prompt instruction (e.g. Rewrite the content as polite customer-support replies)
polish.policyHint: Policy: local model first; auto-fallback to cloud if not downloaded or on failure (no config needed)
polish.cloudEndpointPh: Empty = use Bailian-compatible URL / or fill https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
polish.cloudApiKeyPh: Empty = use the ASR engine's Bailian API key
polish.localModelMovedHint: Local model tiers (fast / balanced / high quality) have moved to the "Local models" card below; download one to enable it. Local first, falls back to cloud on failure.
polish.llmFeatureOff: · Local inference is disabled in this build (rebuild with ./scripts/build.sh)

localLlm.title: Local models
localLlm.policy_cloud: Cloud first (uses cloud when online, falls back to local)
localLlm.policy_local: Local first (private / offline, falls back to cloud)
localLlm.fallbackDesc: When the dedicated translation model is not installed, the same polish model does a two-step translation (Light fix → translate). Lower quality than the dedicated model; for low-end machines / offline.
localLlm.fallbackHint: Hint: when online, cloud is still used by default; the polish model covers offline use or when you skip downloading the dedicated model.
localLlm.noDedicated: No local translation model (cloud / fallback only)
localLlm.noDedicatedDesc: Skip downloading a translation model; translation goes through the cloud or the polish model (fallback).
localLlm.noDedicatedSize: Nothing to download · no extra footprint

engine.title: Recognition engine
engine.modelHintBailian: Model ID supported by your provider (e.g. fun-asr-realtime, paraformer-realtime-v2)
engine.serviceAddrHint: Paste the OpenAI-compatible URL / DashScope URL / bare domain from the console; it is auto-converted to a WebSocket URL (e.g. https://…/compatible-mode/v1)
engine.apiKeyHintBailian: Get the API key from your ASR provider's console

localAsr.title: Local ASR models
localAsr.hint: Download to enable; only one is active at a time and used during recording. Fully offline — audio never leaves your machine.
localAsr.defaultLangHint: Passed as the language param to each local model (directly improves accuracy for SenseVoice/FunASR-Nano)
localAsr.recollectTitle: Re-collect CPU / memory / disk info and re-tag models
localAsr.confirmDeleteModel: Delete the installed "{{title}}" model files? This cannot be undone.

sensevoice.title: SenseVoice
sensevoice.desc: Offline full-clip · CN/EN/JP/KO/Yue · ~240MB · fast, light on resources

funasr_nano_int8.title: FunASR Nano int8
funasr_nano_int8.desc: Offline encoder+LLM · CN(7 dialects)+EN+JP · ~950MB · strong on dialects/noise

funasr_nano_fp16.title: FunASR Nano fp16
funasr_nano_fp16.desc: Offline encoder+LLM · CN(7 dialects)+EN+JP · ~1.5GB · Apple Silicon friendly

hotkey.title: Hotkeys
hotkey.recordHint: Click the button and press the keys you want (combos supported, Esc cancels). Default Fn on macOS; Fn cannot be captured from the keyboard, use the preset button.
hotkey.recordHintWin: Click the button and press the keys you want (combos supported, Esc cancels). Default is CapsLock (hold to talk, release to stop; short taps keep the original caps function). Fn is not recommended (most keyboards handle it in firmware, invisible to the OS). Works even inside openIME windows (raw input fallback); fallback combo Ctrl+Shift+D also registered.
hotkey.fnWarning: Fn needs System Settings → Keyboard → “Press 🌐 (Fn) key to” = “Do Nothing”, otherwise the system swallows the event.
hotkey.fnWarningWin: On Windows the Fn key is consumed by keyboard firmware on most machines and never reaches the OS (a few keyboards except). Fallback Ctrl+Shift+D is also registered; for a single-key experience use CapsLock instead.
hotkey.translateHint: Speak in the source language; the target language appears at the caret.
hotkey.qaHint: Select text, press the key: a QA panel opens, ask by voice, streamed answer.
hotkey.shortPressHint: In Hold mode, recording starts only after {{key}} is held longer than this; releasing earlier does not record (for single keys the original function is re-posted) (100–800, default 300)
hotkey.fnRepostName: Re-post original function on short {{key}} press
hotkey.fnRepostDesc: On Hold + {{key}} tap (below threshold), the key is re-posted so the system performs its original action (e.g. switch input source). macOS only.
hotkey.fnRepostDescWin: On Hold + {{key}} tap (below threshold), the key is re-posted so it works normally; recording starts only when held past the threshold ({{key}} is reserved while recording).

appBehavior.title: App behavior
appBehavior.launchDesc: Auto-start on macOS login, silently resident in the menu bar.
appBehavior.launchDescWin: Auto-start on Windows login, silently resident in the system tray.
appBehavior.muteDesc: When on, system audio playback pauses during voice input and resumes after.

audio.title: Audio
audio.micDesc: Switch and test the current microphone.
audio.micNoSound: No sound detected. Check the microphone or pick another device.

permission.title: System permissions
permission.axDesc: For typing recognized text at the cursor
permission.hintWin: On Windows, go to Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone and enable “Let desktop apps access your microphone”; text input needs no Accessibility permission on Windows. If these items are missing, the system allows by default — just try it.
permission.hint: Install via ./scripts/build.sh install (fixed signing identity "openIME Local Dev") before authorizing; reinstalling with the same certificate usually needs no re-grant. If an old openIME entry still doesn't work: remove the old entry and click "Authorize" above. tauri dev does not use stable signing, so authorization may repeatedly lapse while debugging.

fnTest.title: Function test
fnTest.hint: Press {{key}} to start recording, speak into the microphone, and recognized text appears in the box below in real time. Press {{key}} again to stop.
fnTest.hintWin: Hold {{key}} and speak (release to stop); recognized text appears below in real time. Short taps keep the key’s original function. Combo keys (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+D) also work in toggle mode.
fnTest.resultPh: Recognized text appears here (you can also type and edit)…
fnTest.noResponseHint: If nothing happens, make sure the engine is configured and saved

translate.title: Translation
translate.targetLangHint: Fixed language set; takes effect on the next session.
translate.polishFirstDesc: Cloud: polish + translate in one call; local: Light fix then translate (two steps, slower).

insert.title: Insertion & Clipboard
insert.strategyHint: For remote desktops / secure input that swallow simulated keys, “paste only” is the most reliable.
insert.fallbackAppsHint: When the foreground app matches any entry, paste even in Auto mode.
insert.restoreDesc: About 0.75s after pasting, restore your previous clipboard content unless you copied something else meanwhile.

roles.title: Roles / Style Packs
roles.enabledDesc: Say “assistant name + role” to trigger a role, e.g. “小友翻译我想要走了” translates the content, “小友邮件明天开会” drafts an email. Roles use the same model as AI polish by default (local first) and can be overridden per role on the right. When enabled, dictation inserts as a whole (no streaming).
roles.assistantNameDesc: Wake name for prefix roles (combo words are added to hotwords for accurate recognition); empty disables prefix roles.
roles.draftHint: After creating, keep editing prefix, provider and model here.
roles.prefixHint: Input starting with the prefix is routed to this role; separate aliases with |.
roles.emptyEditor: Select a role on the left to view and edit, or click New.

qa.title: Selection QA
qa.hint: Select text → press the QA hotkey → ask by voice with the recording hotkey → streamed answer. Closing the panel clears context.
qa.saveHistoryDesc: Create one session per panel open, two utterances per round (Q: / A:).

_qa.title: Selection QA
_qa.subtitle: Press the recording key to ask · streamed answers
_qa.noSelection: No selection detected (select text in the target app, then press refresh)
_qa.empty: No questions yet. Press the recording key to ask.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: All speech transcriptions
history.emptySub: Press Fn to start your first voice input
history.confirmDelete: Delete {{count}} record(s) from "{{label}}"? This cannot be undone.

dict.title: Dictionary
dict.subtitle: Custom terms to improve recognition of proper nouns
dict.tipBold: names, technical terms, product names, and abbreviations
dict.tipEnd: — the speech engine will boost recognition weight for these. e.g. "Zhipu", "Paraformer", "AutoGLM". The more frequent or specialized, the more worthwhile adding.
dict.inputPh: Type a term; existing entries auto-match
dict.importHint: Hotwords are used for post-recognition correction (homophone/fuzzy → correct spelling) and to preserve proper nouns during polish
dict.importDone: Import done: {{imported}} added, {{total}} total in dictionary.

qa.title: Selection QA
qa.subtitle: Press the recording key to ask · streamed answers
qa.noSelection: No selection detected (select text in the target app, then press refresh)
qa.empty: No questions yet. Press the recording key to ask.
qa.noKeyBanner: No cloud LLM configured: fill Endpoint + API Key under Settings → AI Polish to use QA
